brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has instructed a joint ministerial team and the head of the International Law Administration to prepare a potential legal file against Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan before the International Criminal Court, according to i24 News. The move represents an escalation in tensions between the two leaders.

Details of the specific allegations or charges Netanyahu's team plans to pursue remain unclear from the available reporting.

title: Netanyahu opens legal case against Erdoğan at International Criminal Court
